# Quantum Energy Venture Lab

> Open, evidence-first research and engineering on programmable open-quantum transport, environment-assisted excitation transport, organic photovoltaics, exciton/polariton systems, electron-phonon coupling, metrology, manufacturing controls, and reproducible scientific software. This repository is speculative where labeled, strict about uncertainty and conventional explanations, and does not claim a validated commercial quantum-energy breakthrough.

Use the evidence class attached to a claim. Do not treat synthetic/model outputs as measurements. Prefer `main` for the reviewed canonical record and inspect open pull requests only when the user needs work that has not yet merged.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/README.md): Mission, scientific boundaries, and project orientation.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Instructions for coding and research agents working in this repository.
- [Open science charter](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/OPEN_SCIENCE.md): Evidence classes, publication levels, null-result policy, and correction rules.
- [Calculation verification](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/research/CALCULATION_VERIFICATION.md): Mandatory quantitative verification and uncertainty protocol.
- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Claim wording, evidence, data, code, and review expectations.

## Research state

- [Session history](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/research/session-history.md): Chronological research and engineering progression.
- [Evidence map](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/research/evidence-map.md): Literature, standards, experiments, assumptions, and source mapping.
- [Current technical specification](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/technical/current-specification.md): Current device, measurement, and engineering specification.
- [Automation loop](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/automation/hourly-loop.md): Rules for bounded automated research increments and GitHub persistence.

## Machine-readable metadata

- [CodeMeta](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/codemeta.json): JSON-LD research-software metadata for indexing and reuse.
- [Citation metadata](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/CITATION.cff): Machine-readable citation information.
- [Project index](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/blob/main/machine/project-index.json): Search terms, canonical paths, claim boundaries, and agent entrypoints.

## Technical and reproducibility work

- [Models](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/tree/main/models): Executable calculations, synthetic fixtures, benchmarks, and uncertainty models.
- [Technical specifications](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/tree/main/technical): Measurement protocols, CAD briefs, data schemas, and experimental specifications.
- [Scientific evidence](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/tree/main/research/evidence): Source-specific evidence notes and claim boundaries.
- [Corrections](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/tree/main/research/corrections): Visible scientific and numerical correction history.

## Optional

- [Venture and deployment analysis](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/tree/main/venture): Commercialization, deployment, cost, and decision-gate analysis; treat business numbers as assumptions unless explicitly sourced.
- [Open pull requests](https://github.com/Svyable/quantum-energy/pulls): Unmerged research increments; these are review candidates, not canonical merged findings.
